description.fallback: Joseph learns from Donovan that Speedwagon is still alive and being held in a secure Nazi base. Joseph sheds tears of joy, then notices Donovan trying to escape and ties him to a cactus. At the Nazi base, Joseph attempts to sneak in by cross-dressing as a girl.

text.fallback: Talk to Robert E. O. Speedwagon
Head out: The Pillar Man, Santana, Part 3

outro.fallback: On the film, they see Santana running towards the wall and suddenly begin shape-shifting his bones and muscles.
He manages to squeeze himself through a metal grate and starts traveling through the Nazi base in the air ducts.
